calendar.title: Calendar subscriptions
calendar.description: Put your DiveDay departures on the calendar you already use. Subscribing is read-only: DiveDay never reads or changes anything in your calendar.
calendar.refreshNote: Your calendar decides how often it re-reads the feed — usually within a few hours, not instantly. Treat DiveDay as the source of truth for a same-day change.

assignments.name: My departures
assignments.detail: Every trip you are assigned to crew, teach, or captain.

shopTrips.name: All shop departures
shopTrips.detail: Every scheduled departure at this shop, whoever is crewing it.

status.neverRead: No calendar has read it yet — paste the link into one to finish.

actions.confirmRotate: Replace this link? Any calendar still using the old one stops updating.
actions.confirmTurnOff: Turn off this subscription? The link stops working immediately.

newLink.heading: Your subscription link
newLink.shownOnce: Copy this now — for your security it is shown once. If you lose it, replace the link to get a new one.
newLink.webcalHint: Opens your calendar app and subscribes.

warning.rotate: Replacing the link stops the old one working right away. Any calendar still using it will quietly stop updating until you paste the new link in.
warning.shared: Anyone with this link can read these departures without signing in. Treat it like a password.

notice.denied: You do not have access to that calendar scope.

calendar.coverage: Covers departures from {past} days ago through {future} days ahead.

staffing.title: Staffing
staffing.description: See who is working, what each person is qualified to teach or crew, and where the next boat still has a coverage gap.

working.heading: Who is working
working.managerOnly: Shift changes require owner or manager

addShift.heading: Add a working shift
addShift.detail: A shift says when someone is available. Assign the actual crew on each trip separately.

coverage.heading: Coverage gaps
coverage.detail: These are prompts to resolve before the manifest becomes a dock-side surprise.
coverage.noTrips: No scheduled trips in this window.
coverage.allGood: Crew is assigned, and their shift covers this trip.

gap.no_shift_coverage: No working shift covers this trip

notice.overlap: That person already has an overlapping shift.
notice.staffNotFound: That staff member is no longer on this shop's team.
notice.invalid: Check the shift date and times, then try again.
notice.notAuthorized: Only owners and managers can change shifts.

main.title: Shop settings
main.description: One-time and occasional shop configuration lives here, including the Stripe account that receives invoices and payments.

notice.packingSaved: Packing checklist saved for every trip.
notice.packingInvalid: Add between one and twelve packing items.
notice.dockSaved: Dock call time saved for every confirmation and reminder.
notice.dockInvalid: Enter a dock call time between 5 and 180 minutes.
notice.rentalPricesInvalid: Enter each price as a dollar amount (or leave it blank), between $0 and $100,000.
notice.contactInvalid: Use a complete email address, or empty the box to take it off your public pages.
notice.reviewUrlInvalid: Enter a full https:// link, or empty the box to stop asking for reviews.
notice.connectFailed: The Stripe connection didn't complete. Try connecting again.
notice.notConfigured: Online payments aren't switched on for this DiveDay setup yet. Whoever runs your DiveDay hosting needs to finish the Stripe configuration first.
notice.notAuthorized: The rental catalog, rental prices, and Stripe connection are payment settings, limited to owners and managers.

contact.heading: Public contact details
contact.description: Printed on your course pages, where a diver who cannot find a date gets a ready-written email to send you. Use a front-desk address the whole team reads, not a personal one. Empty the email box to take the form down.

reviewLink.heading: Review link
reviewLink.description: Your Google Business, TripAdvisor, or Facebook review page. When set, a diver's post-trip recap invites them to leave one — empty the box to stop asking.
reviewLink.label: Review link

packing.heading: Trip packing checklist
packing.description: One item per line. Divers see this same concise list on every trip.

dockCall.heading: Dock call time
dockCall.description: How early divers are asked to arrive before departure — for gear setup, cert checks, and the briefing. It appears on booking confirmations, the dock-day rhythm, and every pre-trip reminder.
dockCall.label: Minutes before departure

paymentsGate.notice: The rental catalog, rental prices, and Stripe connection are payment settings, limited to owners and managers. The contact, packing, and dock-call settings above are open to all staff.

rentals.heading: What we rent
rentals.description: The gear and services divers can ask for when they set their rental fit. Untick anything you don't offer — a shop that doesn't stock GoPros never offers one, and it drops off the kit form and the prep list. Most shops don't fill nitrox, so it starts unticked.

rentalPricing.heading: Rental prices
rentalPricing.description: What a diver is quoted when they set their rental fit. Price the full set for the diver who takes everything (usually cheaper than the pieces), and per-piece for a partial kit — a diver renting all five core items is quoted the set, anyone renting fewer pays per piece. Leave a box blank to settle that item at the shop.
rentalPricing.fullSetHint: (BCD, reg, wetsuit, mask & fins, weights, dive computer)

stripe.notConnectedDescription: Connect a Stripe account you own — DiveDay never holds your money, and payments for orders and invoices go straight into your own Stripe balance.
stripe.notConfiguredWarning: Online payments aren't switched on for this DiveDay setup yet — ask whoever runs your hosting to finish the Stripe configuration.

embed.heading: Website embed
embed.description: Copy-paste snippets that put your live booking calendar on your own website.

data.heading: Data
data.description: Bring contacts in from a CSV, or take everything back out as a ZIP of CSVs — neither one touches the settings above.

founder.heading: Talk to the founder
founder.description: A bad morning at the counter, a feature you're missing, a bug — write in any time. It reaches Aaron directly, not a ticket queue, and reaching out is always welcome.

team.title: Team
team.description: Invite staff, set what each person can do, and manage who still has access.

notice.disabled: Account disabled — they can no longer sign in.
notice.inviteInvalid: Enter a name, a valid email, and check at least one role.
notice.rolesInvalid: Check at least one role before saving.
notice.inviteAlreadyOnTeam: That person already has an account here.
notice.inviteEmailTaken: That email is already registered to a different shop.
notice.lastOwner: Can't do that — the shop needs at least one owner. Make someone else an owner first.
notice.notFound: That person isn't on this shop's team.
notice.notAuthorized: Team management is limited to owners and managers.

invite.heading: Invite someone
invite.description: They'll get an email to set their own password. If they're already a diver at your shop, inviting them by the same email adds staff access to their existing record instead of creating a second one.

current.heading: Current team
current.description: Enable, disable, and delete take effect immediately. Role changes below wait for Save changes.

staffRow.deleteConfirm: Delete {name} from the team? This can't be undone.

export.title: Data export
export.description: Download everything this shop keeps in DiveDay as plain CSV files — divers, cards, trips, bookings, signed waivers, rental sizes, orders, wait lists, dive sites, and courses. Yours to keep, whenever you want it — including a ready-to-import contacts file another system's import wizard can map directly.

downloadButton.acknowledged: On its way — check your downloads

bundle.heading: What's in the bundle
bundle.description: One ZIP with a README and a CSV for each kind of record. Every date and time carries its timezone, money is in cents, and your archived history comes along too — nothing is lost if you ever move on.

notIncluded.label: Not included, on purpose:
notIncluded.text: offline manifest copies saved on staff phones, private staff notes and activity, notification logs, Stripe checkout attempts (every money outcome is in the bookings and orders files), and any pasted image URL a CSV references that was never stored through DiveDay. Every card photo, dive-site image, and course image DiveDay itself stores comes along as a real file in the bundle's <mono>photos/</mono> folder, so it survives even after this account closes. Sign-in credentials and staff calendar-subscription links are never exported. The bundle's README lists the same gaps.

import.title: Import contacts
import.description: Bring your divers, cards, rental sizes, and prior waiver acceptance in from a CSV — from your old system or from DiveDay's own export. We're honest about what comes across: imported cards land verified and flagged imported, with a one-tap confirm on each diver's record, and a row claiming a waiver was already accepted is trusted and marked imported.

comesAcross.heading: What comes across
comesAcross.description: A card already in your system was checked there, so DiveDay trusts it: imported cards land verified and flagged imported, ready from the first trip, with a one-tap confirm for staff, and their refresher-due dates come across too. A specialty card waits on that confirm before it clears the dive it authorizes. Individual medical answers are never reconstructed.

wizard.heading: Upload a contacts file
wizard.intro: A CSV from your old system, or DiveDay's own <mono>contacts.csv</mono> from the data export. Rows with an email are matched to your existing divers, so re-importing one updates that diver instead of duplicating them; rows without an email always come in as new records. Nothing is written until you review the preview and confirm.
wizard.ignoredMedicalColumns: Left behind on purpose: {columns}. These weren't recognized as a waiver column, so their contents never import — individual medical answers are never reconstructed from another system. A recognized “waiver accepted” column is trusted instead; see below.
wizard.waiverRowsNotice: {count, plural, one {# row claims} other {# rows claim}} a waiver already accepted at a prior shop. DiveDay trusts that — including its medical clearance — and marks the record “imported” so it's never confused with a release signed here. See “What comes across” above.
wizard.visitRowsNotice: {count, plural, one {# row records} other {# rows record}} a past visit. Those come across as history on the diver's profile — what was booked, when, and what your old system called it — and nothing more: they never become trips on your schedule, never count toward capacity or reporting, and a booking is not proof anyone dived.
wizard.hiddenRowsNotice: Showing the first {limit} rows. All {total} are imported on confirm.

result.cardsLine: {cardsAdded, plural, one {# card} other {# cards}}, {specialtyAdded, plural, one {# specialty card} other {# specialty cards}}, and {nitroxAdded, plural, one {# nitrox card} other {# nitrox cards}} imported and flagged imported, with a one-tap confirm on each diver's record.
result.rowsMergedNote: {count} row(s) added cards to a diver an earlier row brought in.
result.cardsSkippedNote: {count} card(s) already on those divers' records were left untouched.
result.cardsHeldByAnother: {count} card number(s) in the file are already on a different diver in your shop, so those cards were not added to anyone. Check the file for a repeated number, then enter those cards by hand.
result.specialtyGateNote: A dive that requires one of those specialties waits on that confirm — tap it on the diver's record and the gate opens.
result.waiversLine: {count, plural, one {# waiver} other {# waivers}} imported as accepted, marked “imported” on the diver's profile.
result.waiversSkippedExistingNote: {count} diver(s) already had a current waiver on file, left untouched.
result.waiversSkippedNoTemplateNote: {count} skipped — set up a waiver template first.
result.waiverDocumentsFailedNote: {count} document link(s) didn't fetch and were left off the record.
result.visitsLine: {count, plural, one {# past visit} other {# past visits}} added to divers' shop history.
result.visitsSkippedNote: {count} were already imported and were left as they are — re-running the same export doesn't double anyone's history.

embed.title: Website embed
embed.description: Paste one of these into your own website so divers can browse and book without leaving your site. Both point at the same live schedule — no separate setup, no sync to keep working.
embed.notConfigured: Embed links need a configured public hosting address — ask whoever runs your DiveDay hosting to finish setup before these snippets can be generated.

calendarEmbed.heading: Calendar embed
calendarEmbed.description: A full booking calendar, sized to fit wherever you place it on your page. Best for a dedicated "Book now" page on your site.

bookButton.heading: "Book a dive" button
bookButton.description: A plain link styled as a button, no iframe. Opens your DiveDay schedule in a new tab — the simplest option, and the one to use if you take online payment, since a checkout page may refuse to open inside another site's frame.

embed.footer: Both snippets point at <link>your public schedule</link>. Editing a trip, adding a departure, or changing your rental prices shows up the moment a diver loads the embed — nothing to republish.
